subject: scaling data throughput
text:
Hi [NAME],

Noticed you are gearing up your ML team to accelerate multi-modal sensor
fusion, so I thought now might be a good time to connect.

We partner with AV/perception teams to improve training data quality and
scale annotation pipelines, enabling teams to focus on boosting model
accuracy and speeding up deployment. For context, Encord is a data-layer
scale-up working with 200+ AI teams like Motive and Woven (Toyota).

Would be great to share some insights on how we scale data throughput for
similar customers like you. Are you free Thursday or Friday for a quick
chat?

subject: Coffee @CES [YEAR]?
text:
Hi [NAME] - happy new year! I saw you'll be speaking at the Nvidia panel at
CES - wanted to see if you'd be open to a coffee with the Encord leadership
team in Vegas?

We've been following [COMPANY] for a while and work with other Physical AI
teams e.g. Woven (Toyota), 1X and Physical Intelligence improve annotation
quality at scale.

Autonomous driving teams typically come to Encord to accelerate iteration
cycles between defining new model capabilities and reflecting those in data
curation and annotation strategies.

Our Head of US who leads Physical AI initiatives will be at CES from Wed
(7th Jan) to Friday (9th Jan). How's Thursday afternoon looking for a quick
coffee?

text:

subject: HNY! Data preparation chat
text:

is on your agenda this year so is growing the team for data preparation
pipeline, so I wanted to reach out for a virtual coffee.

You might find our work with other VLA teams - e.g. 1X, Physical
Intelligence and Dyna Robotics relevant. We mainly enable curation and
annotation of time-aligned video data at scale.

models for drone inspection.

Would love to hear what's on the horizon for you in [YEAR]. Would you be up
for a quick chat tomorrow or Thursday morning?

subject: [NAME] - ML Pipelines
text:
